For the class of recreational-type NPA's with off-road capability, gasoline savings from the viewpoint that all impacts are attributable to the AFES can be obtained based on the same fleet characteristics as above except for a fleet size of 40,000 new vehicles. The annual consumption of gasoline for a production weighted fleet average fuel economy in MY 1979 of 16.2 mpg is 679 gallons. The annual consumption of gasoline for a production weighted fleet fuel economy in MY 1979 of 17.4 mpg is 632 gallons. Thus, the annual savings of gasoline per vehicle would be between 4 gallons and 51 gallons and the lifetime savings would be between 40 gallons and 510 gallons. The annual consumption in MY 1976 for the fleet is 27.32 million gallons. The annual consumption in MY 1979 for the fleet would be between 27.16 million gallons and 25.28 million gallons for standards between 16.2 mpg and 17.4 mpg respectively. Thus, the annual savings in gasoline for the fleet would be between 0.16 million gallons and 2.04 million gallons and the lifetime savings for the fleet would be between 1.6 million gallons and 20.4 million gallons.
